$comment: PERSONAL file: copy to ~/.dev-flow/timekeeper.json. No secrets here — Timekeeper and SRM tokens stay in the browser session. Values below come from the original timekeeper-logwork skill (SiliconStack); adjust per person.

timekeeper.$auth: Session cookie from the Microsoft login. All calls run with fetch() inside the logged-in Timekeeper tab; nothing is stored.
timekeeper.reportPathTemplate: /data/get?uri=reports/single-column?filterExp=(startDate Eq `{start}`)and(endDate Eq `{end}`)and(lstUsers In `{userId}`)and(isBillable Eq `2`)and(isOvertime Eq `2`)and(typeChart Eq `column-chart`)and(groupBy In `CustomerName`)

entryFields.$comment: Planner field -> Timekeeper JSON field(s). A list writes the same value to several fields. Verified against a real POST body (startDateTime/endDateTime = same day, duration = hours, ids as strings).

sources.name: WeCRM
sources.jql: project = WEC AND (assignee was currentUser() DURING ("{start}", "{end}") OR (worklogAuthor = currentUser() AND worklogDate >= "{start}" AND worklogDate <= "{end}"))

sources.name: Pentana Integrations
sources.jql: project = NTGRTN AND (assignee was currentUser() DURING ("{start}", "{end}") OR (worklogAuthor = currentUser() AND worklogDate >= "{start}" AND worklogDate <= "{end}"))
sources.skip: Story/Requirement in Analysis Complete, FE/QA sub-tasks, To Do items

meetingsHelp: Each meeting may have optional from/to (yyyy-MM-dd) to limit when it applies.
